name: paxos-r1
cmd: echo SETUP_START=$(date +%s%3N); bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; setup=$?; echo SETUP_EXIT=$setup; [ "$setup" = 0 ] || exit "$setup"; echo HARNESS_START=$(date +%s%3N); timeout -s KILL 60s bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only paxos_epr --skip broken; s=$?; echo HARNESS_END=$(date +%s%3N); echo STRICT_EXIT=$s; exit $s
